heading: INT. BOWLING ALLEY BASEMENT - ROLLER DERBY LOCKER ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. BOWLING ALLEY BASEMENT - ROLLER DERBY LOCKER ROOM - NIGHT
Cinderblock walls, a leaking pipe, the muffled thunder of strikes overhead.
Benches bolted to the floor.
A whiteboard reads "SEMIFINAL."
WANDA "WRECKER" PRUITT (30s, captain, stitches over one eyebrow) laces her skates.
Beside her, DELPHINE ARCEMENT (20s, rookie jammer, wide-eyed) tapes her wrist guards.
SUNNY MAKOA (40s, blocker, built like a refrigerator) eats a banana.
MARGUERITE VOSS (50s, coach, tracksuit, whistle) paces.
GUS TREMAINE (60s, bout announcer, headset around his neck) leans in the doorway.
TINY FOLAU (20s, pivot, five-foot-nothing, enormous voice) sits on a cooler.
Listen up. We are down two points in the standings and they have the best jammer in the league.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: Which is why we skate her into the wall, Coach.
units.name: WANDA

units.text: Wrecker, I thought we weren't allowed to plan that.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Rookie, we're allowed to plan anything. We're just not allowed to get caught.
units.name: WANDA

units.text: Wanda has a point. Also, the wall is very hard.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: Sunny, you ate a whole banana in two bites. Respect.
units.name: TINY

units.text: Tiny, I am a professional.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: Ladies, three minutes to first whistle. Somebody tell me how to pronounce "Delphine Arcement" for the crowd.
units.name: GUS

units.text: Del-FEEN. Ar-suh-MAHN.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Del-FEEN Ar-suh-MAHN. Got it. And you, Tiny?
units.name: GUS

units.text: Tiny. Like the opposite of me.
units.name: TINY

units.text: It's poetry, kid.
units.name: GUS

units.text: Gus, out. Now.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: Out. I'm out. Break a leg, but not really.
units.name: GUS

units.text: Gus exits.
Rookie, you're jamming second period.
units.name: WANDA

units.text: Me? Wrecker, I've only done it in practice.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Practice is where you stop being scared of the real thing.
units.name: WANDA

units.text: I am scared of the real thing.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Good. Scared people duck.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: Delphine. Look at me. You skate the inside line. Sunny and Tiny open the gap. Wanda holds the pivot.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: Hey! Somebody shut off the pipe!
units.name: TINY

units.text: Tiny, it's a basement. There's always a pipe.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: Then we skate like there's no pipe.
units.name: WANDA

units.text: A thunderous strike rolls overhead.
A whistle blows upstairs.
Hands in.
units.name: WANDA

units.text: Wait. Who says it?
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: You do.
units.name: WANDA

units.text: Delphine's hand is shaking.
She puts it in anyway.
Say it, Rookie.
units.name: WANDA

units.text: Say it, Del-FEEN.
units.name: TINY

units.text: ^Say it, kid.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: On three.
units.name: DELPHINE
